title: Zoros Wado Ichimonji
description: This Mod Adds Zoros Wado Ichimonji From One Piece
body:
This Mod Adds Zoros Wado Ichimonji From One Piece.
It Is Very Powerfull And You Can Kill Mobs Whit It.
It has 10 attack dammage and it has 1.6 attack speed.
It also have a cool 3d model that i put alot of effort in to. Hope you like it.
You Can Fraft It With A Iron Sword, 2 Iron Ingots And 4 Iron Blocks Or Give It With This Command: /give @p one_piece:zoros_wado_ichimonji 1
